## Application Overview

MOJO Pro is Joveo's programmatic job advertising platform that helps recruitment teams get job ads in front of the right candidates at the right place, time, and price. Key capabilities include:

- **Overview Dashboard** — spend, clicks, applies, CPC, CPA metrics with trend charts
- **Client Management** — add and manage advertising clients
- **Performance Dashboard** — detailed campaign performance analytics
- **Conversion Tracking** — pixel/conversion tag management
- **Publisher Feeds** — manage job distribution publisher feeds
- **Reports** — generate and export performance reports
- **Tag Management** — tracking tag configuration
- **Markups** — publisher markup configuration
- **Publisher Management** — manage publisher partners
- **Scheduler Tasks** — automated scheduling of tasks
- **User Management** — team user access control

## Test Scenarios

### 1. Authentication & Login

**Seed:** `tests/seed.spec.ts`

#### 1.1 Successful Login with Valid Credentials

**Steps:**
1. Navigate to `https://accounts.joveo.com/login`
2. Verify the heading "Log in to Your Account" is visible
3. Enter email `joveotest@yopmail.com` in the Email field
4. Enter password `JoveoTest@321` in the Password field
5. Click the "Log In" button

**Expected Results:**
- Page redirects to `https://accounts.joveo.com/products`
- Product selection page shows "Welcome Back! Joveo Test"
- "MOJO Pro" product card is visible with description

#### 1.2 Login with Invalid Credentials

**Steps:**
1. Navigate to `https://accounts.joveo.com/login`
2. Enter email `invalid@test.com`
3. Enter password `WrongPassword123`
4. Click "Log In"

**Expected Results:**
- User stays on the login page (no redirect)
- An error message is displayed
- No access to MOJO Pro is granted

#### 1.3 Login with Empty Fields

**Steps:**
1. Navigate to `https://accounts.joveo.com/login`
2. Leave email and password fields empty
3. Click "Log In"

**Expected Results:**
- Validation error shown for required fields
- User stays on login page

#### 1.4 Product Selection — Click MOJO Pro

**Steps:**
1. Complete login steps (1.1)
2. On products page, verify MOJO Pro card shows `mojopro.joveo.com`
3. Click on the "MOJO Pro" heading

**Expected Results:**
- Browser redirects to `https://mojopro.joveo.com/joveo-test/overview`
- MOJO Pro dashboard loads with "Publisher statistics" heading visible
- "+ Add Client" button is visible in the top-right area

### 2. Overview Dashboard

**Seed:** `tests/seed.spec.ts`

#### 2.1 Dashboard Metrics Visibility

**Steps:**
1. Complete the seed login and navigate to MOJO Pro
2. Verify the Overview page URL matches `/joveo-test/overview`

**Expected Results:**
- Page title shows "Overview"
- Breadcrumb shows "Account > Joveo-Test - $ USD"
- Metric cards are visible: Spend, Sp. Clicks, Sp. Applies, CPC, CPA
- Each metric card shows a numeric value
- "Publisher statistics" section heading is visible

#### 2.2 Add Filter Interaction

**Steps:**
1. Navigate to MOJO Pro overview
2. Click "Add Filter" (funnel icon)

**Expected Results:**
- Filter dropdown/panel opens
- Filter options are presented to the user

#### 2.3 Metric View Toggle — Overall vs Breakdown

**Steps:**
1. Navigate to MOJO Pro overview
2. Click the "Overall" dropdown button

**Expected Results:**
- Dropdown menu opens with view options
- User can select different breakdown options

#### 2.4 Date Range Toggle — This Month

**Steps:**
1. Navigate to MOJO Pro overview
2. Click "This Month" date range dropdown

**Expected Results:**
- Date range picker or dropdown opens
- Options include different time period selections (e.g., Last 7 Days, Last Month, Custom)

#### 2.5 Performance Chart — Spend vs CPA Toggle

**Steps:**
1. Navigate to MOJO Pro overview
2. Locate the "Compare performance of" chart section
3. Click the "Spend vs CPA" metric dropdown

**Expected Results:**
- Dropdown opens with available metric pairs
- Selecting a different pair updates the chart visualization

#### 2.6 Add Client Button

**Steps:**
1. Navigate to MOJO Pro overview
2. Click "+ Add Client" button

**Expected Results:**
- A modal dialog or side panel opens for adding a new client
- Form fields appear (Client Name, etc.)

### 5. Session & Security

**Seed:** `tests/seed.spec.ts`

#### 5.1 Page Title Verification

**Steps:**
1. Navigate to MOJO Pro overview after login

**Expected Results:**
- Browser tab/page title is "Mojo"

#### 5.2 Direct URL Access Without Login

**Steps:**
1. In a fresh browser context (no session)
2. Navigate directly to `https://mojopro.joveo.com/joveo-test/overview`

**Expected Results:**
- User is redirected to the login page
- Access to the dashboard is denied without authentication

#### 5.3 Logout Flow

**Steps:**
1. Login to MOJO Pro
2. Navigate back to `https://accounts.joveo.com/products`
3. Click "Log out"

**Expected Results:**
- Session is terminated
- User is redirected to the login page
- Navigating to the MOJO Pro URL should redirect back to login
